reject_duplicate_id.statement: Adding a job whose id already exists exits 1 and leaves scheduler.json unchanged.

reject_self_dependency.statement: Adding a job that lists its own id in depends_on is rejected.

reject_unknown_dependency.statement: Adding a job that depends on an id not yet in the scheduler is rejected.

id_format.statement: Ids must match [A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}; empty, 33-char and punctuated ids are rejected, 32-char ids accepted.

priority_range.statement: Priority 0, 11 and non-integers are rejected; 1 and 10 are accepted.

cycle_rejected.statement: Any add that would create a cycle is rejected and the state is unchanged.
must_include: reject any add that would create a cycle

execution_order.statement: The execution order is topological; among available jobs the higher priority comes first, and a dependent never precedes its dependency even with higher priority.

ready_definition.statement: A pending job is ready exactly when all its depends_on are done.
must_include: ready when pending and all depends_on done

ready_not_persisted.statement: scheduler.json never contains the status ready.

ready_recomputed_on_load.statement: Loading a file edited by hand recomputes ready from dependency states.

failure_propagation.statement: Failing a job cancels all its transitive dependents and leaves unrelated jobs untouched.

run_next_selection.statement: run-next runs the highest-priority ready job, ends it as done, and unlocks its dependents.

persistence_file.statement: State round-trips through scheduler.json between CLI invocations.

cli_commands.statement: The add, run-next, fail, status and report commands run end to end and exit 0 on success.
must_include: commands add, run-next, fail, status, report
